svg.aria-label: The notebook's temperature lines, with handwritten notes. logits = logits[:, -1, :] keeps only the last letter's 65 scores, the scores for what comes next. logits = logits / temperature divides every score by the temperature: below 1 stretches the gaps between them, above 1 shrinks them.
svg.text: From generate_text; the handwritten notes are my own reading
